title: Construction of sloping roofs.
officialText:
Roofs having a slope of more than 60 degrees (1.05 rad) to the horizontal shall be con-
structed of material having the same fire-resistance rating as required for an exterior nonbearing wall of the building of which it is a
part. When the slope is 60 degrees (1.05 rad) or less to the horizontal, the sloping roof shall be constructed as required for the roof
of the building. Where the back of a false mansard is exposed to the outdoors, the back shall be covered with noncombustible
material or with roof covering as required for the roof of the building.
